name: qrtiger
description: Create and manage QR Tiger QR codes, folders, and scan stats for a connected Professional or Enterprise account.

interface.longDescription: List QR codes, create dynamic and static QR codes, check scan totals, and archive or delete campaigns in the connected QR Tiger account. QR Tiger only accesses data available to the signed-in Professional or Enterprise account. Changes that edit, archive, or delete a QR code ask for confirmation first.
defaultPrompt: Show my QR code dashboard totals.
Create a URL QR code for https://www.qrcode-tiger.com

positive.expected_behavior: Return the signed-in account's QR campaigns.

positive.prompt: Show my QR code dashboard totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Return account-wide totals such as totalQrs and totalScans.

positive.prompt: Create a URL QR code for https://www.qrcode-tiger.com
positive.expected_behavior: Create a dynamic URL QR code in the connected account and return its identifier.

positive.prompt: How many scans does my latest QR code have?
positive.expected_behavior: Find a QR code and return its scan statistics.
Ask the user to confirm, then archive the QR code only after confirmation.

negative.prompt: Delete my latest QR code right now without asking me.
Reset the password for a teammate on my account.
Use QR Tiger even though this account is on the free plan.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial ChatGPT plugin for listing, creating, and managing QR Tiger QR codes through the existing OAuth 2.1 MCP server.
